Bug Backlog: project = AUDIO AND type = Bug AND status = Open ORDER BY priority DESC
My Open Tasks: assignee = currentUser() AND status != Done ORDER BY updated DESC
High Priority Issues: priority in (Highest, High) AND status not in (Done, Closed) ORDER BY created DESC
QA Ready: status = 'Ready for QA' ORDER BY priority DESC
Production Issues: labels = production AND status != Resolved ORDER BY priority DESC
